digest.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
digest.tldr: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI.
